# coolify_projects (Data Source)

Lists every Coolify project visible to the configured API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_projects" "all" {}

output "project_uuids" {
  value = data.coolify_projects.all.projects[*].uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `projects` (Attributes List) All projects on the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

### Nested Schema for `projects`
